notes: Decimal DOT '2.5 л.' (not a list number). The title and every list line except the last end with a space. The meatball line hides the only quantity inside the parenthetical '(у меня 600 гр.)' and also says 'по вкусу' about the mince alternative ('фарш+лук/соль'); expected 600 г, not 'по вкусу'. 'Соль/куркума/укроп' is three ingredients split by '/', with hyphenated 'по-вкусу'. Unit 'ст/л.' with a slash. 'либо' is an alternative kept in the name. No steps.
